title: Autorubric: Unifying Rubric-based LLM Evaluation
best_for_zh: 需要构建可校准 rubric Judge 或复用 CHARM-100 类评测数据的研究者。
one_line: Autorubric unifies calibrated, rubric-based LLM evaluation with mixed criterion types, ensembles, and released benchmark artifacts.
统一二元、序数与名义 rubric 的校准、集成评审和可靠性度量，并发布 CHARM-100 等数据制品。
why: It exposes rubric-grounded evaluation signals and their audit boundary.
inclusion_reason: The release provides rubric- or judgment-grounded records that can train, evaluate, or audit LLM-based evaluators.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Rubric evaluation implementations are fragmented: some support only binary criteria, others ask a judge to score many dimensions at once, and calibration, weighting, voting, and psychometric diagnosis are often absent. The same rubric therefore yields incomparable scores across codebases, and judge errors cannot be traced to criterion definition, scale, or aggregation.

Autorubric provides a unified framework for multiple criterion types, single or multiple judges, calibration, voting, and statistical analysis, validated on CHARM-100 and other tasks.

rubric 评测实现分散：有的只支持二元标准，有的把多个维度一次性塞给 Judge，缺少校准、权重、投票与心理测量诊断。结果是同一 rubric 在不同代码库中产生不可比较分数，也难以判断 Judge 错在标准定义、量表还是聚合方式。

Autorubric 提供统一框架，支持多种 criterion 类型、单/多 Judge、校准、投票和统计分析，并以 CHARM-100 等数据验证。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: Autorubric supports binary, ordinal, and nominal criteria with weights, few-shot calibration, option shuffling, length penalties, and majority, weighted, unanimous, or any-vote aggregation. The authors build CHARM-100 with one hundred single-turn chatbot conversations, six criteria, and human ground truth, and validate on RiceChem and ResearcherBench. The project provides the framework and reproduction examples.

Autorubric 支持 binary、ordinal 和 nominal criterion，可配置权重、few-shot 校准、选项随机化、长度惩罚以及 majority、weighted、unanimous、any-vote 等聚合。作者构建 CHARM-100：100 个单轮聊天样本、六类标准与人工真值，并在 RiceChem、ResearcherBench 等任务验证。项目页提供框架、示例与可复现实验入口。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. Declare criterion schemas: Users define criterion type, options, weights, descriptions, and examples in a common schema rather than one holistic prompt.
  1. Run atomic judgments: One or more judges score criteria atomically, with option shuffling and balanced few-shot examples.
  1. Aggregate and calibrate: Voting, weighting, or unanimity rules are selected, with controls for length bias and class imbalance.
  1. Analyse reliability: The framework computes accuracy, kappa, adjacent-grade accuracy, and related metrics; judges, schemas, examples, and seeds must be fixed.

1. 声明 criterion schema： 用户以统一格式定义标准类型、选项、权重、解释和可选示例，避免把多维要求混成一个总提示。
  1. 原子 Judge 调用： 系统逐 criterion 调用一个或多个 Judge，可随机化选项并加入平衡 few-shot 示例。
  1. 聚合与校准： 根据任务选择投票、加权或一致同意规则，并对长度偏差和类别不平衡进行处理。
  1. 心理测量分析： 框架计算 accuracy、kappa、相邻等级命中等指标；复现需固定 Judge 版本、schema、示例和随机种子。

title: Evidence
证据
html: On CHARM-100, binary factual accuracy reaches 87% with Cohen’s kappa of 0.642. Four ordinal criteria achieve 85–93% adjacent-grade accuracy but only 38–58% exact accuracy, showing that near-correct ratings can hide calibration problems. Using the framework for feedback raises a peer-review agent from 0.47 to 0.85, above the 0.82 expert baseline. The protocol is useful, but CHARM-100 is small.

在 CHARM-100 上，二元事实准确性达到 87% accuracy、Cohen’s kappa 0.642；四项序数标准的相邻等级准确率为 85%–93%，但 exact accuracy 仅 38%–58%，揭示粗粒度“接近正确”会掩盖量表校准问题。框架用于反馈后，peer-review Agent 得分由 0.47 升至 0.85，高于 0.82 专家基线；这些结果支持统一协议，但 CHARM-100 样本较小。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Existing rubric tools are tied to one benchmark or output only an average score. Autorubric unifies criterion schemas, judge calls, aggregation, and reliability analysis and supports binary, ordinal, and nominal scales. The novelty is evaluation infrastructure and calibration protocol rather than a new judge model.
现有 rubric 工具通常绑定某个 benchmark 或只输出平均分。Autorubric 的变化是把 criterion schema、Judge 调用、聚合与可靠性分析统一为可配置框架，并同时处理二元、序数和名义量表。新意是评测基础设施与校准协议，而不是新的 Judge 模型。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
1. Limitation 1: CHARM-100 has only one hundred conversations and cannot represent complex multi-turn or specialist tasks.
  1. Limitation 2: A unified framework does not make a rubric valid; ambiguous or incomplete criteria can produce reliable but meaningless scores.
  1. Limitation 3: Multi-judge calibration adds cost, and proprietary model updates cause drift.

1. 局限1： CHARM-100 仅有 100 个对话，无法稳定覆盖复杂多轮和专业任务。
  1. 局限2： 统一框架不会自动保证 rubric 本身正确；模糊或遗漏标准仍会产生可靠但无效的分数。
  1. 局限3： 多 Judge 与 few-shot 校准增加成本，且专有模型更新会导致结果漂移。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
1. Use case 1: Convert existing rubrics into one schema and compare judges, voting rules, and scales.
  1. Use case 2: Use CHARM-100 to examine binary, ordinal, and nominal calibration rather than only overall correlation.
  1. Use case 3: Without human ground truth, first create a calibration set; the framework can improve consistency but not establish correctness.

1. 使用场景1： 可把现有 rubric 转成统一 schema，比较不同 Judge、投票方式和量表的可靠性。
  1. 使用场景2： 可利用 CHARM-100 检查二元、序数和名义标准的校准，而不只看总体相关性。
  1. 使用场景3： 若任务没有人工真值，应先建立小型校准集，否则框架只能提高一致性，不能证明正确性。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: Autorubric unifies criterion types, judges, aggregation, and reliability diagnosis.
  2. Method: Schemas, atomic scoring, multi-judge voting, few-shot calibration, and psychometrics.
  3. Data: CHARM-100 has 100 single-turn conversations, six criteria, and human truth.
  4. Evidence: Factual accuracy is 87%; ordinal adjacent accuracy is 85–93% but exact only 38–58%.
  5. Reuse: Suitable for unified judge pipelines; validate rubric validity and human calibration first.

1. 一句话定位： Autorubric 统一 criterion 类型、Judge、聚合和可靠性诊断。
  2. 方法抓手： schema、原子评分、多 Judge 投票、few-shot 校准和心理测量。
  3. 数据抓手： CHARM-100 含 100 个单轮对话、六项标准及人工真值。
  4. 证据锚点： 事实项 87% accuracy；序数相邻命中 85–93%，exact 仅 38–58%。
  5. 复用决定： 适合构建统一 Judge 管线；必须先验证 rubric 有效性与人工校准。
